Table.Name: Command
Table.Command:
SELECT dbo.Employees.FirstName + ' ' + dbo.Employees.LastName AS FullName , SUM (dbo.Orders.Freight) AS SumOfSales , COUNT (dbo.Orders.OrderID) AS SumOfTransactions
FROM dbo.Employees INNER JOIN dbo.Orders ON dbo.Employees.EmployeeID = dbo.Orders.EmployeeID GROUP BY dbo.Employees.FirstName , dbo.Employees.LastName ORDER BY SUM(dbo.Orders.Freight) DESC
